thread.title: Samsung unveils Galaxy S9 phone, featuring animated human emojis

author: morningstar.com
title: Samsung unveils Galaxy S9 phone, featuring animated human emojis
text:
By Timothy W. Martin
Phone can render a user's selfie into 3-D emoji
BARCELONA -- Samsung Electronics Co.'s newest flagship phone is betting on animated emojis. But of humans, not animals.
Samsung's (005930.SE) Galaxy S9 device, launched Sunday at a Barcelona mobile trade show, looks almost identical to last year's handset: a slim design with an edge-to-edge display and an earphone jack.
But the world's largest smartphone maker saved the big changes for what's loaded onto the device. New video software stores tenths of a second of images that automatically can be turned into GIFs ready-made for social media and messaging apps. Users can create 3-D emojis of themselves by taking a photo of their face, then as their fake cartoonish self, strike real-life poses captured by augmented-reality software.
The Galaxy S9's camera tricks and emoji push are likely to remind some consumers of Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) iPhone X handset last year. Samsung mobile chief D.J. Koh, in an interview, said he had personally explored early 3-D animations since 2001 on flip phones, while leading the firm's mobile research and development team in the U.K. He bristled at any notion Samsung was playing catch-up with Apple, as the human emojis took years of development, he added.
An expanded version of this report appears on WSJ.com (https://www.wsj.com/articles/samsungs-galaxy-s9-phone-bets-on-animated-human-emojis-1519578000?mod=mktw).
